pt_BR.help.title: at-deploy {version}
pt_BR.help.no_args: Sem palavra, o at-deploy imprime esta ajuda.
pt_BR.ca.about: A CA do AT no cofre que o navegador desta máquina lê
pt_BR.ca.install.about: Põe a CA do AT no NSS dos cofres do navegador
pt_BR.ca.uninstall.about: Tira a CA do AT dos cofres onde ela foi posta
pt_BR.ca.ask: Diga o ato e o alvo: `at-deploy ca install [<alvo>]` põe a CA, e `uninstall` a tira. Os alvos são {targets}; sem alvo, todos os cofres que existem nesta máquina.
pt_BR.ca.unknown: Alvo desconhecido: {name}. Os alvos são {targets}; sem alvo, todos os cofres que existem nesta máquina.
pt_BR.install.about: Põe o at-deploy no PATH, e o completion do shell
pt_BR.uninstall.about: Tira o at-deploy do PATH, e o completion
pt_BR.license.about: Diz a licença do AT e o que o artefato carrega; `--include-texts` traz os textos dos terceiros
pt_BR.services.about: O ambiente container, e a virada entre os dois caminhos
pt_BR.services.up.about: Sobe o ambiente e os serviços, nas imagens fixadas — só a primeira vez
pt_BR.services.update.about: Põe a infra inteira no pin do binário desta pasta — imagens, containers, tudo
pt_BR.services.down.about: Abaixa o ambiente: os containers do AT saem, a pasta fica
pt_BR.services.status.about: Mostra o caminho da pasta e o que está de pé.
pt_BR.services.switch.about: A virada para o caminho container, transacional
pt_BR.services.forms.about: Volta o AT ao modo Forms: o ambiente abaixo, e o Forms na porta
pt_BR.services.notify.about: Manda um alerta de teste; com `creds`, mostra a credencial de leitura do celular
pt_BR.services.notify.ask: Diga o quê: `at-deploy services notify` manda o alerta de teste, e `at-deploy services notify creds` mostra a credencial do celular.
pt_BR.services.credential.about: Dá a uma pessoa a credencial que o portão prova
pt_BR.wizard.title: AT — Implantação
pt_BR.wizard.held: Este passo não fechou: leia acima o que ele disse. O próximo só começa quando ele fechar, e a palavra dele vale na linha de comando.
pt_BR.wizard.credential.name: De quem é a credencial? Escreva o nome que o portão prova:
pt_BR.wizard.phone.about: Mostra a credencial de leitura do celular — sorteia se faltar, mostra sempre
pt_BR.error.usage: Use `at-deploy help` para ver as palavras.
pt_BR.error.rejected_arguments: A palavra {word} não aceita argumento nesta versão.
pt_BR.error.read_only: Modo somente leitura: nada foi escrito em {where}.

en_US.help.title: at-deploy {version}
en_US.help.no_args: With no word, at-deploy prints this help.
en_US.ca.about: AT's CA in the store this machine's browser reads
en_US.ca.install.about: Puts AT's CA in the NSS of the browser's stores
en_US.ca.uninstall.about: Takes AT's CA out of the stores it was put in
en_US.ca.ask: Say the act and the target: `at-deploy ca install [<target>]` puts the CA, and `uninstall` takes it out. The targets are {targets}; with no target, every store this machine has.
en_US.ca.unknown: Unknown target: {name}. The targets are {targets}; with no target, every store this machine has.
en_US.install.about: Puts at-deploy on the PATH, and the shell's completion
en_US.uninstall.about: Takes at-deploy off the PATH, and the completion
en_US.license.about: Says AT's license and what the artifact carries; `--include-texts` brings the third parties' texts
en_US.services.about: The container environment, and the switch between the two paths
en_US.services.up.about: Brings the environment and the services up, at the pinned images — the first time only
en_US.services.update.about: Puts the whole infra at this folder's binary pin — images, containers, all of it
en_US.services.down.about: Takes the environment down: AT's containers leave, the folder stays
en_US.services.status.about: Shows the folder's path and what is standing.
en_US.services.switch.about: The switch to the container path, transactional
en_US.services.forms.about: Returns AT to Forms mode: the environment down, and the Forms at the door
en_US.services.notify.about: Sends a test alert; with `creds`, shows the phone's read credential instead
en_US.services.notify.ask: Say what: `at-deploy services notify` sends the test alert, and `at-deploy services notify creds` shows the phone's credential.
en_US.services.credential.about: Gives a person the credential the gate proves
en_US.wizard.title: AT — Deploy
en_US.wizard.held: This step did not close: read above what it said. The next one only starts when it does, and its word works on the command line.
en_US.wizard.credential.name: Whose credential is it? Type the name the gate asserts:
en_US.wizard.phone.about: Shows the phone's read credential — draws it if missing, shows it always
en_US.error.usage: Use `at-deploy help` to see the words.
en_US.error.rejected_arguments: The word {word} takes no argument in this version.
en_US.error.read_only: Read-only mode: nothing was written to {where}.
